s7-shift-lead.desc: a worker in a staff vest with a clipboard

s7-night-visitor.desc: a visitor in a long coat

s7-sister.desc: a woman in a blue headscarf

last-lunch-on-bench-3.1.1.line: {informant} sits alone on bench 3 at the food counter with a bowl of noodles.

last-lunch-on-bench-3.1.2.line: {informant} takes three bites, then sets the chopsticks down across the bowl.

last-lunch-on-bench-3.1.3.line: {informant} slides a folded paper under the bench slat with two fingers.

last-lunch-on-bench-3.1.4.line: {informant} gets up and leaves, the meal half eaten on the tray.

last-lunch-on-bench-3.1.5.line: {veteran-officer} sits on the next bench with the same meal and eats slowly.

empty-bench.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} sits on bench 3 with {veteran-officer.his} meal, and nobody takes the seat beside {veteran-officer.him}.

empty-bench.1.2.line: {veteran-officer} counts the bench slats twice, lips moving.

empty-bench.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} lifts a folded paper from under the slat.

empty-bench.1.4.line: {veteran-officer} unfolds the paper, which reads in pencil: "bench 3, ten past."

empty-bench.1.5.line: {s7-shift-lead} stops at the bench and tells {veteran-officer} one of the crew did not clock in today.

neighbor-at-the-door.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} knocks at door 6B and waits on the landing.

neighbor-at-the-door.1.2.line: {s7-neighbor} opens the next door and steps out to {veteran-officer}, arms folded.

neighbor-at-the-door.1.3.line: {s7-neighbor} tells {veteran-officer} a bag went down to the lift just before midnight last night.

neighbor-at-the-door.1.4.line: {s7-neighbor} shrugs when {veteran-officer} asks who carried it.

neighbor-at-the-door.1.5.line: {veteran-officer} tells {s7-neighbor}: "I will ask again, same hour tomorrow."

flat-6b.1.1.line: {s7-neighbor} reaches a key down from the ledge above door 6B and lets {veteran-officer} in.

flat-6b.1.2.line: {veteran-officer} searches along the shelf, lifting each jar and setting it back.

flat-6b.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} points at a made bed and a single cup on the drying rack.

flat-6b.1.4.line: {s7-shift-lead} knocks at 6B with a folded vest bag over one arm and waits.

flat-6b.1.5.line: {s7-shift-lead} leans the bag against the door of 6B and leaves.

landing-at-03-05.1.1.line: {s7-night-visitor} walks along the dark landing before dawn, flowers wrapped in paper.

landing-at-03-05.1.3.line: {s7-night-visitor} stands at 6C for four minutes, the flowers held low.

landing-at-03-05.1.4.line: {s7-night-visitor} turns and leaves along the landing, still holding the flowers.

lunch-boxes-to-the-lawn.1.1.line: {s7-neighbor} carries two lunch boxes across the edge of the lawn.

lunch-boxes-to-the-lawn.1.2.line: {s7-neighbor} walks to a picnic cloth on the far side of the lawn.

lunch-boxes-to-the-lawn.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} stands on the path on the far side of the lawn.

lunch-boxes-to-the-lawn.1.4.line: {veteran-officer} stays at the end of the path for ten minutes, hands behind {veteran-officer.his} back.

lunch-boxes-to-the-lawn.1.5.line: {veteran-officer} asks {s7-neighbor} the same question as yesterday: "Who carried the bag?"

door-6c-opens.1.1.line: {s7-night-visitor} knocks at door 6C before dawn, flowers in one hand and bread under one arm.

door-6c-opens.1.2.line: The door of 6C opens and {extra:partner} hugs {s7-night-visitor} on the threshold.

door-6c-opens.1.3.line: {s7-shift-lead} hands the folded vest bag to {s7-neighbor} at the door of 6A.

door-6c-opens.1.4.line: {s7-neighbor} shrugs and takes the vest bag inside 6A.

third-cup-on-the-cloth.1.1.line: {s7-sister} spreads a picnic on the lawn: a wicker basket and three tin cups.

third-cup-on-the-cloth.1.2.line: {s7-sister} fills two of the three tin cups and leaves the third empty.

third-cup-on-the-cloth.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} stands on the far path, facing the lawn.

third-cup-on-the-cloth.1.4.line: {veteran-officer} walks past the picnic cloth and does not stop.

second-note-under-slat-3.1.1.line: {s7-neighbor} sits on bench 3 at the food counter just before noon.

second-note-under-slat-3.1.2.line: {s7-neighbor} slides a folded paper under the slat of bench 3.

second-note-under-slat-3.1.3.line: {s7-neighbor} gets up and leaves the counter without ordering.

second-note-under-slat-3.1.4.line: {veteran-officer} reaches under the slat of bench 3 and lifts out the folded paper.

second-note-under-slat-3.1.5.line: {veteran-officer} unfolds the paper, which reads: "bench 3, ten past, eat alone."

sister-s-call.1.1.line: {s7-sister} stands at the picnic cloth with the basket at {s7-sister.his} feet.

sister-s-call.1.2.line: {s7-sister} on the comm, one side: "He eats when the shift is over. Tell the old one, only him."

sister-s-call.1.3.line: {s7-sister} carries the basket off the lawn toward the lift.

found-on-the-lawn.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} walks onto the lawn toward the picnic cloth.

found-on-the-lawn.1.2.line: {veteran-officer} sits down on the cloth beside {s7-sister}.

found-on-the-lawn.1.3.line: {informant} waves once from the edge of the cloth.

found-on-the-lawn.1.4.line: {informant} sits down on the side of the cloth with the third cup.

found-on-the-lawn.1.5.line: {veteran-officer} and {informant} eat the same meal for ten minutes without a word.

found-on-the-lawn.1.6.line: {s7-sister} leans over the basket and hugs {informant} for a long moment.

statement-at-the-desk.1.1.line: {informant} sits at the desk of {veteran-officer} in the station, hands flat on the desk.

statement-at-the-desk.1.2.line: {informant} talks to {veteran-officer} for forty minutes, low and steady, while {veteran-officer} writes.

statement-at-the-desk.1.3.line: {informant} hands {veteran-officer} a bag of folded slips.
